turns.user: Tin tức AI hôm nay có gì nổi bật?
turns.assistant_text:
Dưới đây là một số tin tức nổi bật về AI hôm nay:

1. **[Agentic AI Raises New Questions for Financial Institutions](https://www.wilmerhale.com/en/insights/client-alerts/20261110-agentic-ai-raises-new-questions-for-financial-institutions)** - Bài viết này thảo luận về việc AI không chỉ đơn thuần trả lời câu hỏi mà còn có khả năng hành động. AI có thể thực hiện các giao dịch tài chính cho người dùng, tạo ra những thách thức mới về danh tính và quyền hạn trong các mối quan hệ khách hàng.

2. **[Helping caregivers use AI in everyday life](https://openai.com/index/helping-caregivers-use-ai-in-everyday-life)** - OpenAI đang làm việc với các tổ chức để giúp các nhân viên chăm sóc sử dụng AI trong công việc hàng ngày của họ, nhằm giảm bớt gánh nặng và cải thiện hiệu quả công việc.

3. **[IBM and Microsoft announce a new AI agent platform designed for industry-specific transformation](https://news.microsoft.com/source/2026/11/10/ibm-and-microsoft-announce-a-new-ai-agent-platform-designed-for-industry-specific-transformation)** - IBM và Microsoft đã công bố một nền tảng AI mới nhằm giúp các tổ chức chuyển đổi theo cách mà AI không chỉ là công cụ hỗ trợ mà còn trở thành lợi thế cạnh tranh thực sự.

4. **[Google broadens its AI hardware portfolio with two new specialized chips](https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/10/google-broadens-its-ai-hardware-portfolio-with-two-new-specialized-chips)** - Google đã ra mắt hai loại chip mới nhằm mở rộng danh mục phần cứng AI của mình, giúp cải thiện khả năng xử lý và bảo mật cho các mô hình AI.

5. **[Nov. 18: Carson faculty discuss building AI literacy on Adobe podcast](https://news.wsu.edu/news/2026/11/10/nov-18-carson-faculty-discuss-building-ai-literacy-on-adobe-podcast)** - Một cuộc thảo luận về việc xây dựng khả năng hiểu biết về AI trong giáo dục, nhằm chuẩn bị cho sinh viên không chỉ sử dụng AI mà còn hiểu rõ về cách thức hoạt động của nó.

Nếu bạn cần thêm thông tin chi tiết về bất kỳ bài viết nào, hãy cho tôi biết!

items.title: Agentic AI Raises New Questions for Financial Institutions
items.summary:
DownloadDownload

Artificial intelligence (AI) has moved beyond answering questions and generating content. Increasingly, AI systems are being designed to act. Agentic AI can pursue objectives, make decisions and take actions on a user’s behalf, potentially with limited human involvement in individual decisions. [...] Consider a customer who gives an AI agent access to a bank account with an instruction to manage the customer’s cash efficiently. The agent decides to transfer funds, convert currencies or purchase an investment.

At first sight, these may appear to be ordinary customer transactions. Agentic AI, however, exposes important distinctions between identity, authentication, authority and attribution. [...] As agentic AI becomes more capable, firms may increasingly encounter interactions in which an AI agent collects information, compares products and initiates transactions for a customer. That creates a new layer between the institution and the person or entity with whom it has established a customer relationship.

items.title: IBM and Microsoft announce a new AI agent platform designed for industry-specific transformation - Source
items.summary: “Clients are no longer looking for AI that simply helps people do the same work a little faster. They want to build an agentic business,” said Mohamad Ali, Senior Vice President and Head of IBM Consulting. “Microsoft and IBM are helping organizations bring human expertise and digital labor together in a way that can scale across the enterprise, to turn AI from a productivity aid into a real competitive advantage.” [...] “AI is evolving quickly, and our focus at SEI is on applying it with intention in ways that strengthen trust, enhance human decision-making and create meaningful value across our business,” said Sneha Shah, Chief AI Strategist and Head of SEI Next. “Our work with IBM Consulting and Microsoft is helping us explore how emerging capabilities could support critical processes and be responsibly scaled over time, with the goal to create better experiences for our employees and clients. By combining [...] “Enterprise AI will be won by organizations that can turn their data, industry expertise and AI into action,” said Rodrigo Kede Lima, President, Microsoft Frontier Company. “Together, Microsoft and IBM Consulting are bringing the best of our technology and expertise, to help customers move from AI ambition to business impact faster and with confidence.”

items.title: Google broadens its AI hardware portfolio with two new specialized chips | TechCrunch
items.summary:
The chip launch comes as hyperscalers like Microsoft, Amazon, and even AI labs like OpenAI and Anthropic are working on their own lines of AI-specific semiconductors and accompanying software in order to reduce their reliance on the dominance of Nvidia.

The news also comes at a particularly vulnerable moment for Nvidia, whose CEO Jensen Huang over the weekend admitted to having an affair with someone alleged to be a Chinese spy. [...] Meanwhile, TPU 8i Max basically combines two of the inference-focused TPU 8i chips the company launched in April, doubling the memory capacity, processing power and bandwidth, but in a single package. The result is a chip that lets AI models handle a larger range of information during queries. [...] TPU 8tx, designed with AMD, is based on the TPU 8t chip, and is geared specifically for confidentially training and running AI models, Google said in a blog post. The chip “builds security directly into the hardware layer, keeping sensitive data and model weights protected and isolated even while in active use,” the company wrote.

items.title: Nov. 18: Carson faculty discuss building AI literacy on Adobe podcast | WSU Insider | Washington State University
items.summary:
Crossler, an expert in information systems, leads AI literacy and skill-building workshops on the WSU Pullman and Vancouver campuses with the goal of preparing students not just to use AI but to understand what it does well, where it falls short, and how to use it responsibly. [...] ## Recent News

A laptop sits open on a desk with a large AI microchip icon displayed as a digital overlay above the keyboard. A hand reaches toward the screen area, surrounded by glowing blue technology icons representing artificial intelligence.

### Nov. 18: Carson faculty discuss building AI literacy on Adobe podcast [...] Robert Crossler

During the podcast, Crossler and Cooney will share their experience embedding AI fluency into foundational course work while engaging students in meaningful, team-based projects that mirror real-world business consulting work.
